patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section with a centered, multi-line headline and subtle navigation dots, followed by a responsive grid of project cards.
Oversized, bold sans-serif typography for main headings and a large, faded brand mark in the footer, contrasting with smaller, clean sans-serif for body and detail text.
A high-contrast black and white base palette is consistently punctuated by a single, vibrant orange accent for interactive elements and calls to action.
A cookie consent banner slides into view from the bottom right corner as the user scrolls past the initial viewport.
Content sections are clearly delineated by large, impactful typographic statements and a consistent grid for project showcases.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-width hero section that functions as an image carousel, indicated by a series of small, interactive dots for navigation.

A cookie consent banner is implemented to appear with a slide-in animation from the bottom right of the screen, triggered once the user scrolls down the page, utilizing CSS keyframes for the transition.
Project showcases are presented in a flexible grid layout, where each item combines a striking visual with overlaid text, adapting gracefully to different screen sizes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong hierarchy, complemented by a very large, wide display font for the brand mark in the footer.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded, with sharp corners for content cards and rounded corners for interactive elements like buttons and the cookie banner.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing in the hero and main text sections, balanced spacing within the project grid, creating a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a minimalist black-and-white aesthetic with a single, vibrant orange accent color, combined with large, impactful typography and high-quality, often monochromatic, photography, creates a sophisticated and artistic brand identity. The oversized, faded brand name in the footer is a unique and memorable touch.
